standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings [player name]. Welcome you are in the test of combat.

steps.npc: A spare suit of plate armour need you will. Full helm, plate leggings and platebody yes? Placing it in the centre of the magical machines you will be doing. KA- POOF! The armour, it attacks most furiously as if
alive! Kill it you must, yes.

steps.player: So I use a full set of plate armour on the centre plate of the machines and it will animate it? Then I have to kill my own armour... how bizarre!

steps.npc: Yes. It is as you are saying. For this earn tokens you will. Also gain experience in combat you will. Trained long and hard here have I.

steps.player: You're not from around here are you...?

steps.npc: It is as you say.

steps.player: So will I lose my armour?

steps.npc: Lose armour you will if damaged too much it becomes. Rare this is, but still possible. If kill you the armour does, also lose armour you will.

steps.player: So, occasionally I might lose a bit because it's being bashed about and I'll obviously lose it if I die... that it?

steps.npc: It is as you say.

options.text: Where do the machines come from?

steps.player: Where do the machines come from?

steps.npc: Make them I did, with magics.
A skilled warrior also am I. Harrallak mistakes does not make. Potential in my invention he sees and opportunity grasps.

steps.player: I see, so you made the magical machines and Harrallak saw how they could be used in the guild to train warrior's combat... interesting. Harrallak certainly is an intelligent guy.

steps.npc: It is as you say.

options.text: May I claim my tokens please?

steps.player: May I claim my tokens please?

steps.text: If the player has earned Warrior guild tokens, but has no inventory space:

steps.npc: No space you have carry them for.

steps.player: Right, I need space in my pack for them. I'll be back!

steps.text: If the player has earned Warrior guild tokens:

steps.npc: Yes yes! Earned you have [number] token[s]!

steps.text: If the player has not earned Warrior guild tokens:

steps.npc: No tokens earned have you. In training activities participate you must.

steps.player: Okay, I'll go see what I can find to do around here to earn some tokens.

steps.npc: Health be with you travelling.

standard-dialogue-if-the-animated-armour.npc: Greetings [player name]. Welcome you are in the test of combat.

steps.npc: Correct you are. Not killed it was. Collected your armour I did.

steps.player: Excellent, may I have it so I can try the machine again?

steps.text: If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.npc: Space you will need in your pack.

steps.player: Okay, I'll go make some room in my inventory and come back.

steps.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.npc: It is as you say.

options.text: Where do the machines come from?
May I claim my tokens please?
May I claim my tokens please?

using-any-item-that-isn-t-a-standard-met.npc: Plain full plate armour in those machines only you may use, of appropriate materials. When other items used, bad things happen, yes!

using-any-item-that-isn-t-a-standard-met.player: Okay, so I can only use plain full plate armour of appropriate materials, no trimmed armour or unusual kit?

overhead-dialogue.text: The dialogue is said in the following order every 15 ticks, and starts back from the beginning once the end is reached:

steps.npc: Think not dishonestly.
The Way in training is.
Acquainted with every art become.
Ways of all professions know you.
Gain and loss between you must distinguish.
Judgment and understanding for everything develop you must.
Those things which cannot be seen, perceive them.
Trifles pay attention even to.
Do nothing which is of no use.
Way of the Warrior this is.
